decisions.rationale: Single thick round-topped slab with a carved border, yellow lichen and moss on a small earth base; the most even silhouette.

Single round-topped headstone (Azure concept a, TRELLIS a-s6108). Cooked 2,955 triangles, 94,556 bytes; 1.30 m tall in a 0.40 m reach at uniform scale. Albedo 256 px with 256 px normal and ORM maps (texture memory budget), albedoGain 2.0 against TRELLIS's darkened bake. Reviewed in four views beside the 2.25 m soldier.
limitations: No inscription; the face is pale and lichen-spotted.
TRELLIS invents the unseen back; it is softer than the concept view.
TRELLIS-derived: research and evaluation licence terms, no commercial clearance.
